summary: Iter12 review: Comprehensive backend testing (23/23 pytest) + frontend UI structure verification. All backend endpoints work: discovery optimizer transparency (checks/rank_reason/fail_reasons), stored trades + export_meta.trades>0, fast stored equity (<8s), CSV exports (trades+equity headers correct), history with checks_passed/checks_enabled, dynamic optimizer full pipeline (model regimes >=2, per-regime configs+metrics+baseline_metrics, comparison.dynamic.test + comparison.static.test, verdict recommendation+dynamic_better), dynamic save/list/refresh/apply/delete, backtester regression, apply params with timeframe sync. Frontend UI verified: 4 optimizer mode cards including opt-mode-dynamic present, dynamic mode reveals dyn-settings/dyn-max-regimes/dyn-lookback/dyn-conf-min/dyn-min-hold/dyn-train-pct/opt-strategy, indicator section hidden as expected, dyn-panel-toggle opens dyn-panel-body, opt-history-toggle shows Checks column, all top-5 data-testid selectors (opt-checks-N, opt-rank-reason-N, opt-export-trades, opt-export-equity, opt-equity-toggle) exist in source (Optimizer.js lines 887-1006).

issues: Startup shows several transient 'Failed to fetch' + 401 errors before login token loads (fetchNotif/fetchSession). Minor UX polish - could gate these fetches behind auth token.
React DOM hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option> (dropdown component). Minor - non-breaking.

action_items: Optional: silence startup fetch 401s until admin token is loaded (fetchNotif, fetchSession, etc.).
Optional: fix hydration warning by removing <span> inside <option> in a select component.
critical_code_review_comments: Optimizer.py service is large (~1000+ lines): consider splitting _run_dynamic into its own module (services/dynamic_optimizer.py) for maintainability.
Discovery run picked config where PnL<=0 and still surfaced; ensure rank_reason clearly indicates 'not passed' (currently OK per output).
Reset endpoint /api/optimizer/reset is important for tests but should require admin auth if not already (verify).

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all structural selectors + interactions verified; full end-to-end discovery UI render not observed within 120s poll but not a bug)

seed_data_creation: Created + deleted 1 dynamic strategy 'TEST_dyn_bollinger' via test cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter12_dynamic_optimizer.py can be run with `pytest ... -o addopts=''` because pytest.ini enables xdist loadscope. Dynamic run reuses cached data so tests are quick (~20s total). Optimizer allows only one job at a time - use POST /api/optimizer/reset (requires admin) between runs. History endpoint returns {history:[...]}, dynamic/list returns {strategies:[...]}, backtest run requires 'strategy_ids' (not 'strategies'). Frontend admin auth token localStorage key is 'adminToken' (or 'token'/'admin_token' - test uses all 3 to be safe).
